fbx_export_axes.note: Matches global axis metadata of the retained Shinyeong reference FBX; UE conversion still requires validation.

cross_section_at_north_offset_0_m.limitation: A single east-west intersection of 2025 polygons; not a perpendicular width measurement or 2026 road survey.

limitations: Road corridor includes walkway; it is not verified asphalt width.
2025 mapping is not a 2026 field survey.
Sidewalk height, paving and neutral ground are visual placeholders.
Roof-to-sidewalk gaps and inaccessible regions remain unverified.
Road corridor contains sidewalk polygons; raised sidewalk covers it visually and the reported area includes sidewalks.
Sidewalk is an open surface, not a closed curb solid or a validated collider.
Ground has a rectangular visual clearance based on the old model's below-grade geometry, not a surveyed stairwell.
Collisions, axis conversion, material appearance and placement in UE have not been tested.
